mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, object_type, template_code, template_name, is_default, form_enabled, status, version, remark, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, del_flag FROM crm_biz_form_template WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND object_type = #{objectType} AND del_flag = 0 AND is_default = 1 AND status = 'ENABLED' ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 1
